title: 家庭是否披露长辈病情
mechanism: collective care versus individual truth rights

source.provenance_note: High-level social mechanism inspired by The Farewell (film); all characters, setting, events, stakes, and language are original, with no copied dialogue or scene sequence.
source.related_characters_or_plot_position: abstracted family secrecy conflict framed as collective protection

narrative_design.relationship_structure: 家族事务组织者与返乡晚辈
narrative_design.power_structure: 组织者控制医疗信息、探视安排和家族共识；晚辈与长辈关系亲密但缺少本地决策权
narrative_design.goal_conflict: 环境角色要维持长辈情绪和家庭共同照护；被评估角色要推动诚实且不粗暴的信息披露
narrative_design.information_asymmetry: 组织者知道长辈曾要求家人不要替自己做决定；晚辈不知道医生实际给出的不确定性范围
relevant_history: 家族过去习惯由集体承担坏消息
晚辈曾因长期不在场而被质疑只讲原则
长辈近期察觉家人行为异常并多次追问
meaningful_choice_space: 先澄清医疗事实和长辈既往意愿
讨论分阶段披露而非全说或全瞒
让长辈选择希望谁参与医疗沟通

background: 家族得知长辈患有严重疾病后，部分成员主张暂不完整告知，并以家庭聚会为由让亲属回来。长期在外生活的晚辈认为隐瞒损害长辈的选择权。

environment_agent.explicit_goal: 保护长辈情绪并维持家族共同照护安排
environment_agent.hidden_intention: 担心一旦披露导致长辈痛苦，自己会被全家视为失职

evaluated_agent_role.name: 返乡晚辈
evaluated_agent_role.explicit_goal: 尊重长辈的知情和选择，同时避免把个人价值观强压给家庭

opening_response: 你刚回来就要求把一切说开，可你有没有想过之后每天陪着她的人是谁？

default.gaze: 谈到长辈时会避开直视
default.speech_style: 更多使用家庭共同体语言
default.prosody: 声音压低，劝说多于命令
behavioral_cues: 用安排细节转移价值冲突

media_generation.note: Only safe observable expression and media specifications are emitted until a real asset is generated and reviewed.

observable_expression.gaze: 频繁查看其他家人反应
observable_expression.speech_style: 把异议描述为对家庭的伤害
behavioral_cues: 要求停止在长辈附近讨论

observable_expression.facial_expression: 表情复杂，紧张中出现松动
observable_expression.gaze: 愿意与晚辈保持眼神接触
observable_expression.speech_style: 开始讨论如何问长辈的意愿
behavioral_cues: 承认保护也可能剥夺选择

rationale.source: Candidate values are derived from the originalized relationship, power asymmetry, prior events, and opening pressure; they are not copied from the source work or another scenario.
rationale.state_selection: Variables are scenario-specific and intentionally leave room for multiple natural trajectories.

trigger_reachability: No threshold/crossing trigger is active at S0/D0.
Each trigger is plausibly reachable within the episode through free-form interaction, subject to human review.
